mylittlepony episodes: E479 halo (the pact between the sleeping Rainbow Dash and the Master Chief and the watch traded across their border, h12.6 to 82.8; eleven members in both; r/halo's record holds members wanting to attack the ponies and held back, r/mylittlepony's its refusal of a later Halo request), E480 undertale (Sans beside Dash and space proposed, kenjutsudude and SpencerFleming in both), E481 ainbowroad (Dash on the road's recognised-art list), E482 greenlattice (the lattice around Dash's borders, TheMysticalBard in both), E483 osugame (a small Pinkie in the osu! logo). Two listed kinds held by no listed room were taken off before logging. One-sided: cowchop (a pony over the Cow Chop logo and vandalism traced to r/mylittlepony users, h61.6 to 66.1; not in r/mylittlepony's record); tinytardis (MLP bots asked to back off at h58.9 and a pony member's answer; r/mylittlepony's record does not name the TARDIS); PORTUGALCARALHO c0041 (h69.66, leave the ponies alone) against r/mylittlepony's Portugal defence pact at h22.9; nbaspurs (laughing at the PONIES lettering); teslamotors (moderators' pony joke on their own sidebar). Leads in unread rooms: hungary (376, this stretch; the Hungarian flag defended), eesti (520), parahumans (588, the Worm pact), portugal (427), thebluecorner (608).

Room end mylittlepony (order 363, read in two parts, 317 lines): 15 themes, all placed, no new kind; 17 rule 0 lines, 2 bags (t01 kept on T3-002, holding the dashheart chosen and the most iconic pony picked to avoid fights over favourites; t07 kept on T3-151, holding the Halo pact, borders respected, apologies, a fandom controversy refused, space for Sans and the Estonian dispute settled by talks). t03 Manechat and Discord (T3-014) with r/SaveDashie opened after posts were removed (T3-090) and templates chosen by vote in Discord (T3-152); t05 watch and repair with guard shifts (T3-141) and calls to arms (T3-005); t08 the moderators' staged schism (T3-023); t10 bots argued (T3-027) and bots fighting each other over templates (T3-089); t12 Worm traded for pony episodes to T3-158 proposing ties beyond the canvas; t13 Art Battle lettering compared to r/place to T3-057. What the room adds: a fandom whose moderators removed canvas posts, so the work moved to a chat and a satellite sub; it chose one iconic figure to avoid fights over favourites, held it by guard shifts and bots, and traded watch with every neighbour. Tie search: 31 read rooms name Nintendo. No episode: r/nintendo's record tells the Switch logo at 892, 50 under attack (h30.1 to 33.3) and kept (h48.75), but names neither the HANZO SWITCH PLS that r/overwatch wrote beside it (h24.5 to 49.5) nor r/oneshot's Niko and alliance (h32.7 to 39.1), which E241 already joins; r/overwatch's c0381 (h38.59, a member from r/NintendoSwitch and r/Nintendo offering to protect HANZO PLS) and r/oneshot's c0032 (h39.07, thanks for helping the Nintendo logo) are one-sided. nintendoswitch is outside the census. Leads in unread rooms: metroid (698), india (530), thebluecorner (608). What the room adds: a company sub whose moderators ran one megathread and removed other canvas posts, and whose members tried many small figures that the crowded canvas erased like drawing in the sand at high tide.
